issues.title: At 768px with a case open, the feed shrinks to ~168px and KPI cards run under the detail panel
At 768px the feed's Reason and Cost columns sit past the card edge, reachable only by horizontal scroll
At 375px the Holdout tab is off-screen in the top strip with no scroll cue
Case detail: Net value is not Expected gain minus Cost
Free shipping picks are explained as 'the option that gives away no margin'
